text_block_list.text:
The injury she suffered during training 
was causing her pain, so I took Air Groove 
to the nurse's office, and...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"My assessment was too optimistic, it 
seems. It's entirely my fault."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I must do everything in 
my power now to make up for this delay...!
choice_data_list: Let's rest until your injury heals.
Let's rethink the training menu together.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if I am to stumble over something 
as small as this...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am perfectly calm. And that is precisely 
why...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Kh... First, I must let my injury heal 
completely...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why are you being so leisurely!? We don't 
have time to ponder over a menu.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Right now, even a second sooner, I have to 
make up for lost time...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We'll train within a range that won't 
aggravate the injury. I can't let 
something like this break my spirit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm not panicking at all... Tch.

Air Groove tried to move after saying 
that, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Damn it, I can't even do 
simple stretches properly?

The injury Air Groove was dealing with 
seemed to be more severe than she had 
anticipated...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Coming up with a menu, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
True, letting my thoughts wander is about 
all I'm permitted to do right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well. Then come with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this, we know how much training 
it takes before you get injured.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whether this can truly be called a 
blessing in disguise is certainly up for 
debate, however.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, that means we can 
incorporate training that doesn't exceed 
that limit."

Afterward, the two of them brainstormed 
ideas for an efficient yet more demanding 
training regimen.
